What's wrong or wanted: PRs that only remove a safety switch fail the flag check.

Who it affects: internal only. Flag removal PRs stay red.

Recommended course and why: The flag check passes a PR that only deletes a flag. Removing a flag cannot add risk a new flag would cover.

What Valentin must decide: nothing.

How to undo: revert the PR.

Problem

PR 3587 removes a flag. The feature-flag-gate check still asks for a new flag.

  • Same on 3588, 3547, 3524 and 3522.

Fix

  • The check spots a PR whose changes only remove one flag.

  • That PR passes with a clear reason.

Done when

3587 goes green on a rerun. A test proves a normal UI change still fails.

Risk

This changes a merge gate. It needs three outside reviews first.

raw:
What's wrong or wanted: Each board wants a different ticket format. Good tickets get refused.

Who it affects: internal only. Every agent filing tickets on any board.

Recommended course and why: One ticket format for every board. The task writer writes text the server accepts.

What Valentin must decide: nothing. He asked for one format.

How to undo: revert the PR; no data change.

Problem

One bug report on board 15 was refused five times.

  • It named an error code in the description.

  • A brain label was missing.

  • A repro step counted as technical detail.

  • The board 2060 format was refused here.

  • A template version check gave no reply.

The task writer's own rewrite on SOFT-2585 was also refused as too technical.

Fix

  • One ticket format, the same on every board.

  • The task writer always produces text the server accepts.

  • Repro steps are allowed below the divider.

  • Every refusal names the one part to change.

Done when

The same ticket files cleanly on boards 15 and 2060. A task writer draft passes on the first try. Tests prove both.

Risk

Low. Looser rules may let a vague ticket through. Undo: revert the PR.

Decision

None. Valentin already chose one format.
